BAJAJFINSV: Higher Fair Value And Dividend Outlook Will Shape Future Returns
news.body: Analysts have raised their price target on Bajaj Finserv to ₹1,688 from about ₹1,572, citing updated assumptions that include a slightly lower discount rate, adjusted revenue growth expectations, a modestly higher profit margin outlook, and a higher future P/E multiple. What's in the News Bajaj Finserv declared an annual dividend of ₹1.30 per share, with the payout scheduled for August 4, 2026, and the ex date and record date set for June 30, 2026 (Key Developments).

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 11%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2027 has deteriorated. 2027 revenue forecast decreased from ₹1.75t to ₹1.67t. EPS estimate also fell from ₹82.94 per share to ₹74.23 per share. Net income forecast to grow 21% next year vs 19% growth forecast for Diversified Financial industry in India. Consensus price target broadly unchanged at ₹2,160. Share price rose 4.1% to ₹1,818 over the past week.

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹1.50
news.body: Dividend of ₹1.50 is 50% higher than last year. Ex-date: 30th June 2026 Payment date: 4th August 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.09%, which is lower than the industry average of 1.3%.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹61.30 (up from ₹55.61 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.51t (up 14% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹98.0b (up 11% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 6.5% (down from 6.7% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 9.3%. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 15% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 13% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 9% per year.

news.title: BAJAJFINSV: Upcoming Board Meeting And EV Financing Tie Up Will Support Outlook
news.body: Analysts have maintained their price target for Bajaj Finserv at ₹2,710, keeping fair value unchanged while refining assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E in their updated view. What's in the News Kinetic Watts & Volts has launched a retail finance ecosystem for its DX+ and DX electric scooters that includes Bajaj Finserv as one of the finance partners, alongside Hero FinCorp and CleverPe, to offer EMI-based and digital finance options at Kinetic EV dealerships across India (Key Developments).

news.body: Analysts have made a small trim to their Bajaj Finserv price target, with fair value moving from about ₹2,248.71 to roughly ₹2,226.69. This reflects slightly higher discount rate assumptions and a modestly lower future P/E multiple, while revenue growth and profit margin expectations remain broadly unchanged.

What's in the News Kinetic Watts & Volts has introduced a retail finance ecosystem for its Kinetic DX+ and DX electric scooters, partnering with Bajaj Finserv, Hero FinCorp and CleverPe to provide EMI based and digital finance options at EV dealerships across India (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹14.00 (vs ₹14.00 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹14.00 (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹397.1b (up 27% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹22.3b (flat on 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.6% (down from 7.1% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 15% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 13% per year.

news.body: Bajaj Finserv Ltd. (NSEI:BAJAJFINSV), Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited (BSE:500490) and Jamnalal Sons Private Limited agreed to acquire an additional 26% stake in Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Limited and Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance Company Limited from Allianz SE (XTRA:ALV) for approximately INR 240 billion on March 17, 2025. As per the transaction, stake Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Limited will be acquired at INR 4,808.24 per share and stake in Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance Company Limited will be acquired at INR 2,654.12 per share. A cash consideration will be paid by Bajaj Finserv Ltd., Bajaj Holdings & Investment Limited and Jamnalal Sons Private Limited. Upon completion, Bajaj Finserv Ltd. will own 75.01% stake in Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Limit
